name: neighborhood-sense
description: Lets Claude answer questions about Singapore neighbourhoods using Real Signal's calm-AI substrate. Reads atmosphere, Moment Quality, citizen perception, intent, silence, prediction-track-record, legitimacy index, monthly state-of-pocket reports, live experiences, and per-outlet autopilot backtests. When nothing is live it returns an honest structured fallback (why silent + the pocket's retrospective rhythm) rather than an empty result — never invents, always cites. Read-only.
author: Real Signal Research

tools_excluded.submit_benchmark_predictions: Write tool — out of scope for the calm-AI read-only plugin. Benchmark participants use the underlying MCP server directly via dedicated tooling, not through ambient Claude queries.
